name: implement-navigation-lifecycle
prompt: Implement navigation in a long-lived WPF shell where views subscribe to messages and timers. Prevent duplicate subscriptions and memory leaks across repeated navigation.
rubric: Defines view and view-model lifetime ownership instead of caching every screen indefinitely.
Disposes subscriptions, timers, cancellation sources, and unmanaged resources at explicit lifecycle boundaries.
Includes a repeated-navigation regression test or profiling acceptance criterion.
